title: Spontaneous step-position measurement
purpose: Cover a server-to-client monitoring ASDU with a non-command TypeID, spontaneous cause, step value, and quality descriptor.
expected_behavior: The receiver parses TypeID 5 as M_ST_NA_1 step-position information with spontaneous cause 3, one information object at common address 1 and IOA 1, step value 0, and a clear quality descriptor.
constraints_preserved: The I-format APCI length 0x0f equals four control bytes plus the 11-byte ASDU.
TypeID 5 is M_ST_NA_1 in the supplied monitoring-direction catalog.
VSQ is 1 and the ASDU uses cause 3 for spontaneous transmission.
The information object carries a one-byte step-position value followed by a one-byte quality descriptor.
No CP24Time2a or CP56Time2a field is added because this TypeID has no time tag.
issue_safety_notes: PK-only monitoring seed; direction and spontaneous semantics are represented without malformed framing or issue-specific payload reuse.
